source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot to BIOS setup menu
    2. Check the value of System Language in Main page

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Value of System Language should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: The "System Language" is a BIOS setup-screen preference; it is not exposed to the OS and must be read on the physical setup screen.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator reads the System Language value on the BIOS setup screen; agent cannot view the interactive setup UI over SSH.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that BIOS Main-page System Language matches the project-approved BIOS locale and that the page text is rendered consistently in that language.
original_method: Enter BIOS Setup without changing language, capture the System Language field plus representative Main-page labels, compare them with the approved BIOS locale reference, then exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must read the BIOS language field and visually inspect BIOS label rendering; the OS locale is independent.
safety_requirements: Do not change or save the language setting.
Stop on unreadable/mixed text or an unexpected change prompt.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare locale/reference comparison and collect non-invasive context.
Analyze supplied images for field/text consistency.
Report without claiming the UI observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply expected language/reference and approve window.
Observe/capture the field and representative labels.
Exit without change and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no normal SSH command proves BIOS Setup language or rendering.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain visual BIOS inspection; OS locale may be recorded only as unrelated context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System Language Main-page check and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the selected language plus representative labels/glyphs on the same build to detect mixed locale, truncation or missing characters.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS build and supported locale set.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds rendering consistency evidence without changing the setting.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS language does not establish BIOS language.

project_override_considerations: The project selects the expected supported BIOS language; evidence must state which locale was checked and cannot generalize to untested translations.
expected_evidence: Unchanged setting and normal boot/log recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All primary fields target BIOS System Language. The unspecified project locale is readiness, not contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual objective is clear; locale reference and console availability govern readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds representative rendering evidence and separates project input from BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Checks both the selected value and visible localization quality while preventing OS locale substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The accepted result is firmware UI state and rendering, neither exposed by ordinary OS inventory. Human visual observation is core, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter Setup or change language automatically after a mismatch; preserve the UI evidence and stop.
